performance.verdict: Meta drives all 150 leads; Google burns $1,019 with zero conversions confirmed.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $1,019.28 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions across 171 clicks — every dollar is unattributed spend with no lead return.
Meta is sole lead driver: 150 leads, $17.24 CPL over 28 days. 3-day signal (Aug 18–20: 7+12+8 leads) vs prior 3 (Aug 15–17: 0+0+2 leads) shows a sharp rebound after a dark gap.
SOW milestone 'Stripe Products QA'd & Done' (due 2026-07-20) has no confirmed completion event in GHL data — revenue and won-opportunity count both read 0.
GHL shows 166 contacts and 136 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — leads are entering the pipeline but not progressing; intake or follow-up is leaking, not ads.
GBP actions fell 61.54% week-over-week (to near zero last 3 days); series shows GBP spiked Aug 18 (4 actions) then dropped to 0 on Aug 19–20 — directional concern, thin data.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Search to Meta immediately; Google has 0 conversions on $1,019 spend over 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Reduce Google Search daily budget by $15/day and add it to the Meta campaign currently delivering leads at $17.24 CPL. Google Ads produced 0 conversions on $1,019.28 of spend over 28 days while Meta drove all 150 leads. Success check: Meta CPL stays at or below $20 and weekly lead volume holds above 27 (last 7-day count) by 2026-08-28. If Google conversion tracking is confirmed broken (pixel issue) before then, pause this shift and fix tracking first.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion pixel immediately; 171 clicks, $1,019 spend, 0 conversions is almost certainly a tracking failure, not zero intent.
suggestions.monday_update: Pull the Google Ads conversion tag from Tag Manager or the site and fire a test click-through to confirm the tag fires and a conversion registers in the Google Ads UI. The account logged 171 clicks and $1,019.28 spend with 0 recorded conversions over 28 days — this is the known client-side pixel issue flagged in the data. If the tag is broken, fix and verify by 2026-08-25; if it fires correctly, the search campaign has zero intent match and the budget shift in S1 becomes permanent.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL pipeline: 136 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm automated follow-up sequences are firing on new contacts.
suggestions.monday_update: Check that the post-lead automation sequences in GHL are actively enrolling new contacts and that the Becklar/BWS intake paths are not creating duplicate or unmapped opportunities (per open SOW milestone from 2026-07-20). With 136 opportunities created and 0 won over 28 days, no appointment volume, and 0 revenue recorded, the pipeline is stalled downstream of ads. Success check: at least 5 appointments booked in GHL within 7 days of fix (by 2026-08-28).
